message.content:
Here are the best sources for **free 3D game assets** in 2026, organized by category:

## Top Free 3D Model Libraries

### **Kenney.nl**
- **40,000+ CC0 assets** with a consistent, clean low-poly style
- Includes 2D sprites, 3D models, UI elements, fonts, and audio
- No attribution required; perfect for rapid prototyping
- Also offers free tools like **Asset Forge** for creating custom 3D models

### **Quaternius**
- Thousands of **modular, themed asset packs** (fantasy, sci-fi, nature, animals, vehicles)
- All **CC0** — rigged and animated characters ready for Unity, Unreal, or Godot
- Signature bright, charming low-poly style

### **Sketchfab**
- **500,000+ free downloadable models** with interactive 3D preview
- Various licenses (many CC0 or CC-BY)
- Great for browsing before downloading

### **Poly Haven**
- **CC0** PBR textures, HDRIs, and 3D models
- Realistic props and environmental pieces
- No sign-up required

### **TurboSquid Free Section**
- Professional-grade, royalty-free assets
- Higher polygon count, detailed textures — suitable for AAA-style projects

### **PolyScann**
- All models **completely free (CC0)** — no attribution needed
- Game-ready topology with PBR textures
- Compatible with Unity's Built-in, URP, and HDRP render pipelines
- Categories include buildings, medieval props, industrial assets, and general props

## Free Textures & Materials

| Platform | Best For | License |
|----------|----------|---------|
| **ambientCG** | 2,000+ PBR materials, up to 8K/16K resolution | CC0 |
| **CGBookcase** | High-quality PBR textures with tutorials | CC0 |
| **Textures.com** (free tier) | 15 free credits daily for high-res textures | Mixed |

## Free Characters & Animations

- **Mixamo** (Adobe): Free rigged characters and motion-captured animations with auto-rigging for custom models. Free for commercial use with Adobe ID.

## Engine-Specific Free Assets

| Platform | What You'll Find |
|----------|----------------|
| **Unity Asset Store** (free filter) | Unity-ready 2D/3D packs, demo content from professional publishers |
| **Unreal Engine Marketplace** (free) | Characters, environments, blueprints, VFX for Unreal projects |
| **Godot Asset Library** | 2D/3D assets, plugins, and demos tailored for Godot |

## Community & Indie Sources

- **itch.io/game-assets/free**: Indie-friendly complete game kits, pixel art, 3D models, audio
- **OpenGameArt.org**: Massive community-driven library with various open licenses (check each asset)

## Important Tips

1. **Always check the license**: CC0 = do anything; CC-BY = requires attribution; some have commercial restrictions
2. **Stick to 1-2 visual styles** per project for a cohesive look
3. **Recommended formats**: GLB/glTF (fastest integration, 60% quicker), FBX (Unity/Unreal standard), OBJ (simple static models)
4. **Quality check**: Aim for 5K-50K polygons for characters, <5K for props, and minimum 1024x1024px textures

Sources:
1. https://www.seeles.ai/resources/blogs/free-3d-game-assets
2. https://assethoard.com/blog/where-to-find-free-game-assets-2026
3. https://gamineai.com/blog/top-15-free-game-development-asset-packs-2026
4. https://polyscann.com/blog/post/best-free-3d-assets-for-unity-2026
5. https://polyscann.com/zh/blog/post/best-free-3d-assets-for-unity-2026
6. https://teachaitools.blog/blog/ai-game-art-generators-2025
7. https://www.getly.store/blog/top-rpg-game-assets-and-ui-kits-free-2026-2d-sprites-tilesets-animations
8. https://spawnicon.com/best-ai-generated-game-icon-packs-for-indie-developers-in-2026-premium-vs-free-a-2
